title: Brand24 vs Mention: Budget Social Listening Head-to-Head
summary: Brand24 vs Mention compared on price, mention caps, and what you actually get per dollar in 2026 — plus why Mention's "budget" plan isn't budget anymore.
body_markdown:
**TL;DR:** Brand24 and Mention get shortlisted together because both built their reputation as accessible, self-serve monitoring tools — but only one of them still is. Brand24 still offers five tiers starting at $199/month, letting a team enter at a real budget price and scale up. Mention discontinued its Solo, Pro, and Pro Plus plans in July 2025; the only plan new customers can buy today is the Company Plan at $599/month, annual-only, with a hard 50,000-mention monthly cap. At that identical $599/month price, Brand24's Business tier delivers double the mention volume (100,000/month) and five times the alert capacity (25 keywords vs. 5 alerts). Neither platform transcribes audio or reads on-screen text in TikTok or Reels video — both are caption-and-hashtag monitoring tools at every tier.


Brand24 and Mention show up on the same "budget social listening" shortlists for a reason: both started as the accessible alternative to enterprise tools like Brandwatch and Talkwalker. The comparison used to be straightforward — cheaper self-serve option A versus cheaper self-serve option B.


That comparison broke in 2025. Mention quietly discontinued its lower tiers, and the platform that used to start under $50/month now has exactly one plan, priced at what used to be enterprise-adjacent money. Brand24 didn't follow — it still runs a genuine five-tier ladder.


This is a straight price-and-value comparison: what does each platform actually give you per dollar in 2026, and which one still deserves the "budget" label.

## Brand24: Still a Real Budget Ladder


Brand24 runs five genuine tiers, from Individual at $199/month up to a custom Enterprise quote above $1,499/month (Source:[Brand24 Pricing, 2026](https://brand24.com/prices/) ). Even the entry tier is self-serve — no sales call required to start at $199/month for 2,000 mentions and 3 keywords, with 12-hour update cycles.


Move up the ladder and the value scales sensibly: Team ($299/mo) jumps to 10,000 mentions and hourly updates; Pro ($399/mo) adds real-time updates and the first AI layer (sentiment, Events Detection, AI Insights on 2 projects); Business ($599/mo) triples mention volume again to 100,000/month and expands to 25 keywords with priority support. Reviewers rate the platform 4.2/5 across G2, Capterra, and Trustpilot, with 93% saying they'd recommend it (Source:[Reddinbox, Brand24 Alternative Analysis, 2026](https://reddinbox.com/blog/best-brand24-alternative) ).


**Where Brand24 wins on value:** A genuine entry price under $200/month, five tiers that each meaningfully expand mention volume and features, and no annual-contract requirement to get started.


## Mention: The Budget Plan That Isn't Budget Anymore


Mention's pricing story changed in July 2025, when the platform discontinued its Solo ($49/month), Pro ($99/month), and Pro Plus ($179/month) tiers for new signups (Source:[CheckThat.ai, Mention Pricing 2026](https://checkthat.ai/brands/mention/pricing) ). Existing subscribers on those plans were grandfathered in, but "if you cancel a legacy subscription, Mention will not reactivate it" (Source: same). The only plan a new customer can buy today is the Company Plan: $599/month, annual-commitment-only, with a hard cap of 50,000 mentions per month shared across every alert and workspace — once you hit it, "Mention stops collecting new data entirely until your 30-day cycle resets" (Source:[CheckThat.ai, 2026](https://checkthat.ai/brands/mention/pricing) ).


That cap comes with only 5 alerts included, versus Brand24's 25 keywords at the identical $599 price point. Historical data access — up to two rolling years — is a paid add-on with unpublished pricing, requiring a direct account-manager conversation (Source: same). Mention also retired its Publish and Respond features in January 2026, redirecting customers who need social publishing to a separate Agorapulse subscription (Source:[Mention Pricing FAQ, 2026](https://mention.com/en/pricing/) ) — the result of Mention's 2025 acquisition by Agorapulse following a 2024 bankruptcy (Source:[FrenchWeb, 2026](https://www.frenchweb.fr/) ; reported deal value ~€4.67M).


**Where Mention still wins:** Broad platform coverage (1 billion+ sources across social, news, blogs, forums, and 75+ review sites) and no keyword-count ceiling within its 5 alerts — each alert can run more complex Boolean queries (up to 22 operators, 2,000 characters) than Brand24 allows per keyword.


**Where it's lost ground:** There's no longer a genuinely cheap entry point. A solo marketer or small team that used to start at $49/month now has to commit to $599/month annually — the same price as Brand24's fourth tier out of five — just to get in the door.


## The Real Insight: Same Price, Different Value


Line the two platforms up at their closest comparable price point and the gap is stark. At $599/month:


-


**Brand24 Business** gives you 100,000 mentions/month and 25 keywords, real-time updates, and AI Insights across 5 projects.


-


**Mention Company** gives you 50,000 mentions/month and 5 alerts, with historical data and API access both requiring separate negotiation.


Brand24 delivers roughly double the mention volume and five times the keyword/alert capacity for the identical monthly spend. Mention's remaining advantage — source breadth and per-alert query complexity — matters more for teams tracking a small number of very specific, high-nuance topics than for teams that need to cover a lot of ground on a budget.


Neither platform closes the gap that matters most for beauty, F&B, and fashion brands in 2026: video content. Brand24's own TikTok tracking is "public mentions, hashtags, and virtually any keyword associated with your brand" — a text-matching mechanism with no audio transcription or on-screen text detection at any tier (Source:[Brand24, TikTok Mentions, 2026](https://brand24.com/blog/tiktok-mentions/) ). Mention's TikTok coverage is similarly caption-and-hashtag-based. **Untagged mentions** : brand conversations spoken aloud or shown on-screen inside a video — never typed into a caption, tag, or hashtag — are structurally invisible to both platforms, regardless of which tier or plan you're on.[Syncly Social](https://syncly.app/social) was built specifically to catch what neither budget tool can:[video-content analysis](https://syncly.app/social/feature/video-analysis) that transcribes what's actually said and reads what's actually shown on-screen.

-


**If you want the cheapest genuine entry point and room to scale up gradually →** Brand24, starting at $199/month.


-


**If you need very complex Boolean queries on a small number of topics and can absorb the $599/month annual commitment →** Mention's Company Plan.


-


**If your budget caps out around $599/month and you want the most mention volume for that spend →** Brand24 Business beats Mention Company on raw capacity.

## Key Takeaways


-


Mention discontinued its Solo ($49/mo), Pro ($99/mo), and Pro Plus ($179/mo) tiers in July 2025 — the only plan available to new customers now is $599/month, annual-only


-


Brand24 still runs a genuine five-tier ladder from $199/month to a custom Enterprise quote, with no annual-contract requirement to start


-


At the identical $599/month price point, Brand24 Business gives 100,000 mentions/month and 25 keywords versus Mention Company's 50,000 mentions/month and 5 alerts


-


Mention retired its Publish and Respond features in January 2026 following its 2025 acquisition by Agorapulse, redirecting those needs to a separate subscription


-


Neither platform transcribes audio or detects on-screen text in TikTok or Reels video at any tier — both remain caption-and-hashtag monitoring tools


## Is Mention Still a Budget Tool?


Not for a new customer in 2026. The "budget" label made sense when Mention's entry price was $49/month; it doesn't at $599/month annual-only, especially when a direct competitor delivers twice the mention volume at the same price with no annual lock-in required. Brand24 has kept its budget positioning intact — a real sub-$200 entry point, a ladder that scales sensibly, and month-to-month flexibility. If price-per-mention is the deciding factor and video coverage isn't a requirement, Brand24 is the stronger budget pick in 2026. If your team's real gap is that neither tool can hear what a creator says or see what's shown on-screen in a video, that's a different problem — and it's the one worth solving before optimizing the rest of the budget.
